# 2 Chronicles Chapter 25 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Son-of twenty-and-five years reigned Amaziah and-twenty-and-nine years he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-name-of his-mother was-Jehoaddan from-Jerusalem.

**2** And-he-did the-right in-eyes-of YHWH only not with-a-heart complete.

**3** And-it-was when was-firm the-kingdom upon-him and-he-killed his-servants the-ones-who-struck the-king his-father.

**4** And-their-sons not he-killed but as-written in-the-law in-book-of Moses that commanded YHWH saying not shall-die fathers for sons and-sons not shall-die for fathers but each in-his-sin they-shall-die.

**5** And-he-gathered Amaziah Judah and-he-stationed-them according-to-houses-of fathers to-commanders-of the-thousands and-to-commanders-of the-hundreds for-all Judah and-Benjamin and-he-mustered-them from-son-of twenty years and-upward and-he-found-them three-hundred thousand chosen going-forth to-war holding spear and-shield.

**6** And-he-hired from-Israel a-hundred thousand mighty-of valor for-a-hundred talents-of silver.

**7** And-a-man-of God came to-him saying O-king do-not let-go with-you army-of Israel for YHWH is-not with Israel all sons-of Ephraim.

**8** But if going you be-strong for-the-battle He-will-make-you-stumble God before an-enemy for there-is power in-God to-help and-to-make-stumble.

**9** And-he-said Amaziah to-man-of God and-what to-do for-the-hundred talents that I-gave to-troop-of Israel and-he-said the-man-of God there-is to-YHWH to-give to-you more than-this.

**10** And-he-separated-them Amaziah to-the-troop that came to-him from-Ephraim to-go to-their-place and-it-burned their-anger exceedingly against-Judah and-they-returned to-their-place in-burning-of anger.

**11** And-Amaziah he-strengthened-himself and-he-led his-people and-he-went to-valley-of the-salt and-he-struck sons-of Seir ten thousand.

**12** And-ten thousand alive took-captive sons-of Judah and-they-brought-them to-top-of the-cliff and-they-threw-them from-top-of the-cliff and-all-of-them were-dashed-to-pieces.

**13** And-sons-of the-troop that returned Amaziah from-going with-him to-the-battle and-they-raided cities-of Judah from-Samaria and-to Beth-horon and-they-struck from-them three thousand and-they-plundered plunder much.

**14** And-it-was after came Amaziah from-striking Edomites and-he-brought gods-of sons-of Seir and-he-set-them-up for-him as-gods and-before-them he-bowed-down and-to-them he-burned-incense.

**15** And-it-burned anger-of YHWH against-Amaziah and-He-sent to-him a-prophet and-he-said to-him why did-you-seek gods-of the-people that not delivered their-people from-your-hand.

**16** And-it-was as-he-spoke to-him and-he-said to-him as-a-counselor to-the-king did-we-make-you stop for-yourself why should-they-strike-you and-he-stopped the-prophet and-he-said I-know that determined God to-destroy-you for you-did this and-not you-listened to-my-counsel.

**17** And-he-took-counsel Amaziah king-of Judah and-he-sent to Joash son-of Jehoahaz son-of Jehu king-of Israel saying come let-us-face-each-other.

**18** And-he-sent Joash king-of Israel to Amaziah king-of Judah saying the-thistle that was-in the-Lebanon sent to the-cedar that was-in the-Lebanon saying give your-daughter to-my-son for-a-wife and-it-passed a-beast-of the-field that was-in the-Lebanon and-it-trampled the-thistle.

**19** You-said behold you-struck Edom and-it-lifted-you your-heart to-boast now stay in-your-house why should-you-engage-in-strife with-evil and-you-fall you and-Judah with-you.

**20** And-not listened Amaziah for from-God it was so-as-to-give-them in-the-hand for they-sought gods-of Edom.

**21** And-he-went-up Joash king-of Israel and-they-faced-each-other he and-Amaziah king-of Judah at-Beth-shemesh that is-for-Judah.

**22** And-was-defeated Judah before Israel and-they-fled each to-his-tent.

**23** And Amaziah king-of Judah son-of Joash son-of Jehoahaz captured Joash king-of Israel at-Beth-shemesh and-he-brought-him to-Jerusalem and-he-broke-down in-wall-of Jerusalem from-gate-of Ephraim to gate-of the-corner four-hundred cubits.

**24** And-all the-gold and-the-silver and-all the-vessels the-found in-house-of God with Obed-edom and-treasures-of house-of the-king and-sons-of the-pledges and-he-returned to-Samaria.

**25** And-he-lived Amaziah son-of Joash king-of Judah after death-of Joash son-of Jehoahaz king-of Israel fifteen years.

**26** And-rest-of acts-of Amaziah the-first and-the-last are-they-not behold written on book-of kings-of Judah and-Israel.

**27** And-from-the-time that turned Amaziah from-after YHWH and-they-conspired against-him a-conspiracy in-Jerusalem and-he-fled to-Lachish and-they-sent after-him to-Lachish and-they-killed-him there.

**28** And-they-carried-him on the-horses and-they-buried-him with his-fathers in-city-of Judah.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **25:2**: not with-a-heart complete — The Chronicler's most common diagnosis of mediocre kings: partial obedience, incomplete devotion.

- **25:9**: there-is to-YHWH to-give to-you more than-this — The man of God's response reframes the economic loss: God's resources exceed any sunk cost.

- **25:14**: he-brought gods-of sons-of Seir — The theological absurdity: Amaziah adopts the gods of the people he just defeated. He worships losers' gods.

- **25:20**: from-God it was — Divine hardening. Amaziah's refusal to listen is attributed to God's judicial purpose, triggered by idolatry.


— EMET
